subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 10: revises a, s, t, p, i, n, d, f, k, c, e, o; builds CVC words (f-i-n, c-a-t, s-i-t); segments and blends

show.line: Let's build words! Sound by sound. c, a, t. Cat!

rounds.prompt: Listen. f, i, n. What word is it?
rounds.praise: Fin! A fish has a fin.

rounds.prompt: Listen. s, i, t. What word is it?
Break it up! Say the sounds in pot.
Listen. d, o, g. What word is it?

hints: Say each sound. Then push them together.
Look at the middle letter. Is it a, i, o or e?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. f, i, n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! f, i, n makes fin.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. f, i, n. Fin!

parent_line: Can blend and read three-letter words like cat, sit, pot and pen.
